--- /private/var/folders/0q/2rdtymtx2yvgjq38pr1pm2lc0000gn/T/opencode-skill-state-one-shot/20260902T234713Z/skill-state/mini-template/README.md

@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+# Mini Template
+
+A dependency-free TypeScript template renderer for Bun.
+
+## Use as a library
+
+```ts
+import { render } from "./src/engine.ts";
+
+render("Hello, {{user.name}}!", { user: { name: "Ada" } });
+```
+
+`{{path}}` escapes HTML; `{{{path}}}` does not. Supported blocks are `{{#if path}}...{{else}}...{{/if}}` and `{{#each path}}...{{else}}...{{/each}}`. Loops expose `{{this}}` and `{{@index}}`; ordinary paths continue to resolve from the root data object. Comments use `{{! comment }}`.
+
+## CLI
+
+```sh
+bun run src/cli.ts TEMPLATE_FILE DATA.json
+```
+
+The command writes rendered output to stdout. Errors are sent to stderr with a non-zero exit code.
+
+## Test
+
+```sh
+bun test
+```

input.command:
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
printf '{{name}}: {{#each items}}{{@index}}={{this}};{{else}}empty{{/each}}' > "$tmp/template.txt"
printf '{"name":"A&B","items":["<one>","two"]}' > "$tmp/data.json"
bun run src/cli.ts "$tmp/template.txt" "$tmp/data.json" > "$tmp/rendered" 2> "$tmp/rendered.err"
success_status=$?
printf '{{#if enabled}}x{{/each}}' > "$tmp/bad-template.txt"
bun run src/cli.ts "$tmp/bad-template.txt" "$tmp/data.json" > "$tmp/bad.out" 2> "$tmp/bad.err"
error_status=$?
printf 'success_status=%s\n' "$success_status"
printf 'stdout='
cat "$tmp/rendered"
printf '\nstderr='
cat "$tmp/rendered.err"
printf '\nerror_status=%s\n' "$error_status"
printf 'error_stderr='
cat "$tmp/bad.err"
rm -rf "$tmp"
